management-and-governance.text: DanDrit USA owns approximately 97% of the outstanding equity interests of DanDrit Denmark. As a result of the Share Exchange, we changed our management and reconstituted our board of directors. As of the effective time of the Share Exchange, Samir Masri, the Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, President, Secretary and sole director of Putnam resigned as the sole officer and director of the company and appointed NE Nielsen, Dr. Jacob Rosenberg, Dr. Eric Leire, Aldo Petersen and Robert E. Wolfe as directors of Putnam, and Dr. Eric Leire as Chief Executive Officer and President and Mr. Wolfe as Chief Financial Officer, Treasurer and Secretary.
The information required to be provided herein is set forth in “Executive Compensation” in the S-1 Registration Statement and is incorporated herein by reference.
